payload.reason: The evidence provides specific improvements in task success rates and rewards when comparing reinforcement learning methods to supervised training methods.

claims.text: The proposed reinforcement learning method improves task success rate by 14.9% to 15.3% compared to supervised learning models.
Reinforcement learning enhances model robustness against diverse dialog situations compared to supervised learning, which has limited capabilities due to the training corpus.
Jointly optimized models using reinforcement learning outperform agent-update-only models, indicating significant improvements over supervised training methods.
